BiblicalUsage: The Levites appoint Heman, and Asaph, and of the sons of Merari, Ethan the son of Kushaiah. One verse names him, and his father with him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ethan the singer is named by his father, and Kushaiah's son sang before the ark.
